While conducting regular patrol in the area of West Mirror Drive, I observed a truck being operated above the posted speed limit and in a reckless manner. Using my department-issued speed detection device, the vehicle was recorded traveling at 54 MPH.

In addition to the speeding violation, the driver was observed operating the vehicle in a reckless manner, including unsafe maneuvering and failure to maintain proper control, creating a potential hazard to public safety.

I activated my emergency lights and siren and initiated a traffic stop. The vehicle complied and came to a stop at Mirror Park without further incident. I made contact with the driver and informed her of the reason for the stop.

During the interaction, the driver was requested to provide identification and vehicle documentation. The driver stated that she did not possess a valid driving license. The driver was cooperative during the encounter.

pd_citations.incident_report:
While conducting routine patrol in the Rockford Hills area, I observed an ambulance traveling at a high rate of speed. Using my department-issued speed detection device, the vehicle was recorded traveling at 90 MPH. At the time of observation, the ambulance was not operating emergency lights or sirens and was not responding under Code 2 or Code 3.

Due to the excessive speed and improper operation of an emergency vehicle, I activated my emergency lights and initiated a traffic stop. The ambulance complied and pulled over in the Rockford Hills area without further incident.

I made contact with the driver and informed him of the reason for the stop. During the interaction, the driver was requested to provide identification and vehicle documentation. The driver stated that he did not possess a valid driving license. The driver was cooperative during the encounter.

Based on the confirmed violations, enforcement action was taken in accordance with traffic laws and emergency vehicle operation regulations.

pd_citations.title: Traffic Stop
pd_citations.incident_report:
While conducting a routine patrol in the area of Carcer Way / Abe Milton Pkwy, I observed a vehicle bearing number plate 36FGH890 traveling at a recorded speed of 64 km/h in a posted 50 km/h zone. The vehicle was being operated in a reckless manner, demonstrating unsafe control of the roadway.

Due to the driver’s reckless operation, the vehicle lost proper traction and slipped onto the grass/roadside area, further creating a danger to public safety.

A traffic stop was conducted, and the driver was advised of the violations. A citation was issued for speeding and reckless driving in accordance with traffic enforcement procedures by Officer Kakashi Hatake.

thread_replies.author: Tasin
thread_replies.content:
While on duty, I, Officer Tasin Rhaman, received a complaint from Mr. Fin Win regarding an incident that occurred at Bean Machine.

According to the complainant, a group of approximately twelve (12) individuals arrived at the location for food. During their visit, an unidentified male suspect wearing a blue hoodie and a face mask allegedly approached one of their female friends, who is employed at EMS.

The suspect reportedly made inappropriate physical contact (“bad touch”) with the victim without consent and further asked her if she provides Telegram nude show services. The act was described as harassment and inappropriate behavior in a public place.

The suspect's face was covered with a mask, making identification difficult. No further identifying details were provided at the time of reporting.

4. Witnesses Present

The following individuals were listed as witnesses:

Shukna Khan

Gafor

Box

Rahamen Daket

Farukh

Storm Shadow

Sultan Khan

Brook

thread_replies.author: Tasin
thread_replies.content:
Actions Taken by Reporting Officer {Tasin rhaman}

Received and reviewed the complaint filed by Fin Win (CID: 1272) regarding inappropriate physical contact and sexual harassment at Bean Machine.

Collected and documented written statements from:

Anaya Wales (CID: 1216) regarding suggestive comments made toward her while on duty.

Dollar Massimo Kane (CID: 276) regarding a suspect offering 10,000 taka to a female employee to accompany him to a hotel.

Contacted two listed witnesses, Farukh Ahamed and Storm Shadow, four days after the incident to obtain their written statements.

Both individuals stated they needed time to discuss before submitting statements.

I provided them with my name and contact information for follow-up.

As of today, they have not contacted me.

Contacted the complainant, Fin Win, again and requested complete and updated witness information for further investigation.

Visited Bean Machine and spoke with the management regarding the incident.

Management stated that similar harassment-related incidents have occurred recently and such behavior has been happening frequently at the location.
